questions.markdown:
Design a circuit using a single op-amp to get the following output voltage:

$$
V_o = 10V_1 + 5V_2 - 0.5V_3 - 4V_4
$$

where $V_1$, $V_2$, $V_3$ and $V_4$ are input voltage sources. Provide the circuit diagram with suitable resistor values.

In an op-amp, when non-inverting input voltage $v_1 = 50\ \mu\text{V}$ and inverting input voltage $v_2 = -50\ \mu\text{V}$, the output voltage is $10\ \text{V}$. For the same op-amp when $v_1 = v_2 = 10\ \text{mV}$, the output is $0.2\ \text{V}$. Determine the CMRR of the op-amp.

(i) With the help of a circuit diagram, illustrate how the output resistance of an op-amp can be practically determined.

(ii) Suppose the output of op-amp is $5\ \text{V}$ when no-load is connected, and the output is $4.5\ \text{V}$ when a $500\ \Omega$ load is connected, determine the output resistance of the op-amp.

Design a high-pass Butterworth filter having $5\ \text{kHz}$ cutoff frequency and $24\ \text{dB}/\text{octave}$ gain roll-off in the stopband. Calculate the overall gain in the passband of the designed circuit.

Analyze the op-amp circuit shown below and draw its input and output waveforms if

$$
v_{in} = 50\sin(200\pi t)\ \text{mV}.
$$

questions.markdown: Draw the circuit of dual-slope ADC and explain its operation while converting an analog input signal of $7\ \text{V}$ into $8$-bit digital output with a reference voltage of $-10\ \text{V}$.

Draw the circuit of $4$-bit binary weighted resistor DAC with $R = 18\ \text{k}\Omega$ and reference voltage of $5\ \text{V}$. Determine the value of feedback resistor required to get full-scale output of $-7.5\ \text{V}$.

Also find the resolution of this DAC.

(ii) Compute the free-running frequency, lock-in range and capture range of PLL with $R_T = 10\ \text{k}\Omega$, $C_T = 0.01\ \mu\text{F}$, $C = 10\ \mu\text{F}$ and supply voltage is $\pm 5\ \text{V}$.
Illustrate how the LM317 IC can be used as an adjustable voltage regulator.
